title: Fitness-beats-truth theorem in evolutionary game theory

tellings.quote: In in fact, what we discovered is the probability is zero that any sensory system has ever been shaped to see any true feature of objective reality.

plain: Don Hoffman, a scientist who studies how we perceive the world, describes a result he calls "fitness beats truth," built on evolutionary game theory, the maths of how traits win out under natural selection, a field shaped by the biologist John Maynard Smith and rooted in Darwin. He says his team found the chance is zero that any creature's senses evolved to show the world as it really is, only what helps it survive. If true, he suggests, it could mean much of reality, maybe even other intelligences, is hidden from us.
